Sam (StellarPay): Hey team — we'd like to onboard a fraud scoring stack for transaction scoring + reranking. It's a small ensemble: a 7B reranker + a lightweight 70M classifier. Key asks: EU data residency, HSM for key wrap, no raw logs persisted, and strict latency (p50 ~40ms, p99 <200ms). Also contract renewal in ~30d so timeline matters. Anyone available to triage?
Maria (CS): Thanks Sam — we can take this. Quick Qs: expected steady qps and peak spikes? Do you already have an eval dataset and labels we can use?
Sam (StellarPay): Steady ~40 qps, peaks up to ~120 qps around EOD settlement windows. We have 1M historical labeled decisions (anonymized), can share via Secure FTP. No PHI but cardholder region constraints (EU only).
Devin (Solutions): Got it. For latency/throughput we'll need workload profile + sequence length distribution. Also: do you prefer Hosted with stricter privacy controls or Dedicated (reserved capacity)? Given p99 target and spikes, Dedicated might be safer.
Alyssa (AM): PSA — renewal negotiation starts in 30 days. If onboarding slips we'll risk churn. Suggest prioritizing Dedicated trial and a short SOW addendum that locks a 3-month ramp. I'll flag with accounts.
Leo (Safety): Also need to define failure modes: acceptable false positive rate (we're often trading false positives vs revenue). What are business harm thresholds? Also need explainability signals for appeals.
Sam (StellarPay): Business target: keep false positive <0.5% at production threshold, precision@50 target 92%. Appeals require top-3 signal reasons. We already have some LIME-like feature attribution baked into the model.
onboard-bot: Onboard checklist created: [Intake form] [SLA draft] [Data transfer plan] [HSM/KMS integration] [Eval harness link] [Canary policy] [Dedicated capacity request]. See: https://redwood.internal/onboard/1745000000
Devin (Solutions): Proposed simple canary policy snippet: 
```json
{"canary_pct":10, "min_calls":2000, "monitor": ["latency_p99", "false_pos_rate", "error_rate"], "rollback_on": {"latency_p99": ">250ms", "error_rate": ">=1%"}}
```
Devin (Solutions): We'll need the eval harness plus a 5k-sample labeled holdout to smoke latency/quality. Can Sam drop sftp creds to secure channel?
Maria (CS): Action items: 1) Sam to upload anonymized eval subset to SFTP and confirm EU residency flag. 2) Devin to size Dedicated pool and draft canary runbook. 3) Leo to define safety gating checklist (appeals + FP thresholds). 4) Alyssa to draft SOW addendum for fast-track onboarding before renewal. I'll set a kickoff for tomorrow 10:30am CET.
Sam (StellarPay): On it — I'll DM SFTP creds and confirm timeline. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :pray: 
Alyssa (AM): Noted — will put renewal watch on this account and propose a 90-day pilot credit to mitigate churn risk. :thumbsup:
Maria (CS): Thanks everyone — tagging follow-ups in the ticket #CS-4821. I'll post minutes after the kickoff. :spiral_note_pad:
